map_dataset_dict: map a function over all splits in a DatasetDict to transform examples in batches
filter_dataset_dict: filter examples in a DatasetDict using a predicate function applied to all splits
shuffle_dataset_dict: shuffle all splits in a DatasetDict with a configurable random seed
push_dataset_dict_to_hub: push a DatasetDict to the Hugging Face Hub as a Parquet dataset with sharding
load_dataset_dict_from_disk: load a previously saved DatasetDict from a local or remote filesystem path
